profile.headline: Software Engineer | React | TypeScript | Ruby on Rails | PostgreSQL
profile.summary:
Hi, I'm Stella. I fell in love with coding after writing my first few lines of Javascript in 2019 and instantly knew a career transition from marketing into engineering was in store for me. After attending Fullstack Academy's full-time immersive bootcamp, I landed my first official engineer role at VTS where I continued to grow and learn daily.

In my two year at VTS I had the opportunity to contribute to 10 features within the core product and was called on to lead cross-team collaborative projects due to my communication skills, all while quickly learning the Ruby language and Ruby on Rails. I'm really proud that after just one year I was promoted to a second level engineer (E2).

Along with my coding knowledge, I have eight years experience across most disciplines in marketing, from graphic design to event planning to branding (and everything in between). Now I'm looking to combine my communications skills, project management expertise, and love for code and problem-solving in my next role as a Fullstack Engineer.

_________________________________________________________________________________

S K I L L S:
Proficient: Javascript, React, Redux, Node.js, Express, Ruby, Ruby on Rails, TypeScript, Sorbet

Knowledgeable: React Native, Expo, Firebase, Firestore, Elasticsearch

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
-Contributed to developing 10 new features within the company’s flagship product using Ruby on Rails, React, TypeScript, Redux, and PostgreSQL
-Reduced manual effort by 75% by implementing a worker that automates data updates pulled from a data team AWS S3 bucket
-Built and led the development of several RESTful APIs to support the mobile team’s release of a new approvals feature
-Wrote extensive unit, feature, and integration test coverage for new features and reviewed team members' pull requests for approval
-Acted as a rotating sprint-lead: led squad SCRUM ceremonies (stand-up, backlog refinement, retrospective) and presented in sprint demos
-Conducted apprentice program interviews and 20+ system design interviews with candidates of all engineering levels
-Promoted to second level Software Engineer (E2) in one year
